newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Microsystems EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied Microsystems EPS.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist cut its 1997 earnings estimate for Applied Microsystems Corp to $0.71 a share from $0.77 but maintained its buy rating, the brokerage said in a report.
-- Sales of the company's CodeTest product so far have fallen short of expectations, the brokerage said.
-- H&Q sees the company earning $0.51 a share this year, compared with $0.15 in 1995.

-- Applied Microsystems, which makes software for testing embedded microprocessor systems, was down three at 10-5/8 after posting third-quarter earnings of $0.14 per share, in line with expectations and up from $0.08 a year earlier.
